name: kneeling battling ropes
description: Making waves with heavy ropes while kneeling. It raises your heart rate and burns the shoulders and arms.
instructions: Kneel in front of the anchored ropes and hold an end in each hand.
Brace your abs and keep your chest up.
Raise and lower your arms alternately to create waves.
Keep the waves quick and steady.
Work for a set time, then rest.
